cases.name: pyro_positive_fee_accounting
cases.requirement: A positive gate fee ($1/kg paid to obtain feedstock) must reduce annual profit by mass in kg times $1.
cases.interpretation: Upstream --battery-fee CLI says negative means recycler is paid. This result checks the reverse paid-fee direction using its own convention.

cases.name: pyro_negative_gate_fee_income
cases.requirement: Negative gate fee -$2/kg should increase revenue/profit by $2/kg at unchanged throughput.
cases.interpretation: Verifies the supported positive-income side of the gate-fee handling.

cases.name: localized_hazard_control_and_pilot_yield
cases.requirement: Economics must incorporate site-specific safety/compliance costs and pilot recovery yields.
cases.actual: Original default parameters only; no field, regulator, or plant records provided.
cases.expected: Local project feedstock, compliance CAPEX/OPEX, verified yield and buyer prices.
cases.interpretation: The upstream model has parameters but no verified local inputs; a synthetic profit output cannot establish investment economics.

probes.relevant_scope: Route/fee scenario computation; not recycler permit, plant profitability, safety or observed performance.
probes.commercial_reuse_permission: MIT file in checked repo; third-party workbook/data/embedded assets and derivative license compatibility not independently assessed.

cases.name: threshold_selection
cases.requirement: Elevated water-level fractions above 0.5 are selected, without normal/missing/invalid stations.
cases.interpretation: Synthetic values exercise the upstream station normalization and risk filter; thresholds are not calibrated for real rivers.

cases.name: missing_level_handling
cases.requirement: Missing station levels return no risk fraction rather than a fabricated warning.

cases.name: nonfinite_sensor_level_is_excluded
cases.requirement: NaN water-level readings must not be returned as candidates for an operational highest-risk list.
cases.interpretation: Nonfinite measurements are invalid telemetry; passing them into risk sorting can mislead downstream processing.

cases.name: local_warning_distribution_and_health_outcomes
cases.requirement: A forecast/threshold module must be paired with validated local alert delivery and downstream response.
cases.expected: Site-calibrated telemetry, uncertainty, actual recipient alerts, response timestamps and health outcomes.
cases.interpretation: No live station feed, dissemination authority or health endpoint was tested.

probes.relevant_scope: Station threshold/ranking utilities; not weather forecast skill, alert delivery, local calibration or reduced harm.
probes.commercial_reuse_permission: MIT license in checked repo; external data provider and operational regulatory requirements unresolved.

cases.name: esphome_yaml_syntax
cases.requirement: Configuration must parse as valid YAML before considering firmware build.

actual.parse_error:
while parsing a block mapping
  in "<unicode string>", line 110, column 5:
      - file: "image.png"
        ^
expected <block end>, but found '-'
  in "<unicode string>", line 114, column 5:
        - file: "moderate.png"
        ^

cases.interpretation: PyYAML syntax parser, NOT ESPHome schema validator or firmware compiler.

cases.name: display_image_identifiers
cases.requirement: Every face image referenced by the display lambda must be declared as a configuration image.
cases.interpretation: Static reference check; not an ESPHome C++ lambda compilation.

cases.name: licensing_provenance
cases.requirement: A verifiable distribution/reuse license must be established before commercial component reuse.
cases.interpretation: No LICENSE/COPYING file in checked snapshot. This is a documentation gap, not a definitive legal ruling.

cases.name: firmware_compile_and_sensor_calibration
cases.requirement: Compile the configuration, flash approved hardware, calibrate SCD30 readings against a reference and test sensor faults.
cases.actual: No ESPHome compiler, ESP32/T-Display hardware, or physical calibration instrument in this trial.
cases.expected: Successful current-version ESPHome compile, hardware test and calibration trace.
cases.interpretation: Static syntax failure already blocks firmware testing; hardware/clinical effect cannot be inferred.

probes.relevant_scope: Configuration plausibility, not actual CO2 sensing, school ventilation or respiratory outcome.
probes.commercial_reuse_permission: No license file detected in pinned repository; clarify rights before reuse.

scope: Cloned checked upstream revisions; synthetic calculation/risk logic and static YAML only; no device calibration, live flood forecasts, academic effect estimation or independent business demand.
execution_safety: Manual source review before import; research scratch clones and local interpreter on authorized device, NOT OS-level network/isolation sandbox.
